verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a framework whose ecosystem includes AutoGen Studio, which can set up and test endpoints, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The JSON team specifications and component serialization describe agent configurations, not an API spec, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
